variants.key_config: Configure item category group ERLA, higher-level item category, and sub-item category assignment.

g1|core|material determination|manual ma.title: Manual Material Selection in Sales Orders
g1|core|material determination|manual ma.story: When a customer orders a specific product, the system can show a list of similar or alternative products so the sales person can pick the right one. Specifically, for manual material selection, the Sales and Distribution (SD) module uses a condition technique to present a selection list to the user during order entry, allowing the order processor to manually choose the substitute material to be ordered. If this setup is missing, the system does not offer any alternatives and keeps the original material unchanged. Without this configuration, sales representatives cannot offer promotional or replacement products to customers on the fly.
g1|core|material determination|manual ma.why_business_needs_it: It allows sales teams to view and manually select alternative materials during sales order entry to handle out-of-stock items or promotions. This improves customer satisfaction and ensures accurate order capture.

g1|core|material determination|automatic.title: Material Determination -- Automatic Material Substitution (A1)
g1|core|material determination|automatic.story: Imagine you order a blue crayon, but the factory is out of blue, so the system automatically swaps it for a special sparkling blue crayon without you even asking. In SAP Sales and Distribution (SD), material determination allows the system to automatically substitute an entered material with a predefined alternative during sales order processing based on condition technique. Plain meaning: the substitution type is set to automatic, ensuring the requested material is replaced by the substitution material in the main item without generating sub-items.
g1|core|material determination|automatic.why_business_needs_it: It allows businesses to automatically fulfill orders using replacement products when primary items are discontinued, out of stock, or superseded, preventing order re-entry and maintaining sales momentum. It guarantees seamless customer service by executing substitutions transparently without manual intervention.

g1|core|material determination|product h.title: Material Determination -- Product Hierarchy / Generic Article Substitution (C1)
g1|core|material determination|product h.story: Imagine a smart cash register that automatically swaps out a generic clothing item in a customer's shopping cart for the exact size and color variant from the product hierarchy when you enter the order. In SAP S/4HANA Order-to-Cash, material determination uses condition technique with usage FASH and strategy A004 to automatically substitute main items with specific sub-items based on product hierarchy groupings.
g1|core|material determination|product h.why_business_needs_it: This setup allows fashion and retail businesses to process generic article orders seamlessly by automatically exploding them into specific SKU sub-items during sales order entry. It reduces manual entry errors and ensures accurate inventory allocation at the variant level without requiring the order taker to manually search for specific sizes and colors.

modules.role: Executes condition technique for material determination in the sales document, substituting the entry material and generating sub-items.
modules.hands_off_to: LE (Logistics Execution) for outbound delivery processing of the generated sub-items.

modules.role: Receives the sub-items generated by material determination for picking, packing, and delivery creation.
modules.hands_off_to: FI (Financial Accounting) for billing and revenue recognition.

g1|panel|material determination.otc_impact: Material determination sits at the foundational entry point of Order-to-Cash, automatically exchanging ordered material numbers for substitute articles during sales order entry based on customer requirements or stock availability. For sales operations, this process modifies order items, impacts subsequent outbound deliveries and warehouse picking, and ensures accurate billing and revenue recognition against the correct material SKU. Any failure in substitution rules directly corrupts the customer experience through unfulfilled commitments, delayed shipments, or incorrect invoice pricing.

panel_qa.question: How do we handle customer dissatisfaction when an automatic material substitution (A1) replaces a discontinued item without prior alignment?
panel_qa.how_to_answer: Automatic material substitution safeguards order fulfillment by seamlessly swapping obsolete SKUs for approved successors during sales order creation via access sequence logic in condition tables. SAP executes this configuration using substitution procedure assignment at the sales document type level in transaction VOV8, linking to VB (Substitution) procedure types. The leadership value lies in maintaining high On-Time In-Full (OTIF) delivery metrics while preventing manual order entry bottlenecks and lost sales. Next, we ensure customer master flags enforce strict warning dialogues if substitutions require commercial sign-off before document saving. The weak answer is to claim we disable automatic substitution entirely, which leads to chronic stockouts and manual order processing overhead.
panel_qa.trap: Claiming we disable automatic substitution entirely, which leads to chronic stockouts and manual order processing overhead.

panel_qa.question: What are the financial implications and revenue recognition risks when using product selection with sub-items (B1) where a kit or promotional bundle breaks down into individual components?
panel_qa.how_to_answer: Product selection with sub-items allows a main material item to explode into component sub-items in the sales order, supporting accurate inventory valuation and cost of goods sold (COGS) posting. SAP achieves this by setting item category group OBA on the main item and defining usage SUB1 in transaction VOV4 to drive sub-item category generation. The financial value is ensuring precise profitability reporting per component while maintaining a single commercial price point on the main item. Next, we monitor billing relevance flags to ensure only the main item generates billing documents while sub-items remain statistical for delivery and pricing. The weak answer is to bill every sub-item individually without checking pricing element conditions, resulting in double-billing the customer for the entire bundle.
panel_qa.trap: Billing every sub-item individually without checking pricing element conditions, resulting in double-billing the customer for the entire bundle.

panel_qa.question: How does condition technique-based material determination integrate with our pricing and ATP (Available-to-Promise) checks during order entry?
panel_qa.how_to_answer: Material determination executes during sales document pricing and scheduling routines immediately after master data read, substituting the material before ATP check execution. SAP processes this via access sequences attached to material determination procedure groups assigned in transaction OVRF and maintained in VB11. The technical value is ensuring that ATP checks and pricing condition records apply against the correct substituted SKU rather than the initial inquiry material. Next, we configure copy controls in VTLA to ensure substitution reasons flow seamlessly from sales orders to outbound deliveries. The weak answer is assuming ATP runs before material determination, which causes stock checks to validate against non-existent or discontinued inventory.
panel_qa.trap: Assuming ATP runs before material determination, which causes stock checks to validate against non-existent or delayed inventory.

panel_qa.question: What governance controls prevent unauthorized users from creating or modifying material determination condition records in production?
panel_qa.how_to_answer: Material determination master data governs automated order processing and must be strictly controlled through transport management rather than direct production maintenance. SAP enforces this by restricting transaction VB11, VB12, and VB13 access via authorization object V_KUNA with activity parameters restricted to specific user profiles. The risk mitigation value is preventing unauthorized SKUs from substituting active products, which protects order accuracy and audit compliance. Next, we implement Change Document logging on table KONH and KONP to track all condition record modifications. The weak answer is allowing regional customer service leads to update substitution rules directly in production without change control tickets.
panel_qa.trap: Allowing regional customer service leads to update substitution rules directly in production without change control tickets.

panel_qa.question: How do we manage manual material selection (A2) where customer service representatives need a pop-up window to choose from a list of valid substitutes?
panel_qa.how_to_answer: Manual material selection presents sales reps with an interactive selection screen containing valid substitute materials during order entry when stock is constrained. SAP enables this functionality by setting the substitution indicator in the material determination procedure to manual selection mode (strategy type with dialog flag) in transaction OVRF. The operational value empowers customer service to negotiate alternative products directly with the buyer while preserving order cycle time. Next, we train agents on reading ATP availability columns within the selection pop-up to make informed fulfillment decisions. The weak answer is stating that manual selection requires custom ABAP dialog programming instead of leveraging standard SAP SD condition technique dialogs.
panel_qa.trap: Stating that manual selection requires custom ABAP dialog programming instead of leveraging standard SAP SD condition technique dialogs.

panel_qa.question: What is the impact of product hierarchy substitution (C1) on our EDI 850 inbound sales order processing and error handling?
panel_qa.how_to_answer: Inbound EDI 850 purchase orders containing obsolete customer material numbers must trigger automatic material determination during IDoc processing to prevent order failure. SAP handles this by ensuring the ORDERS05 inbound function module executes standard pricing and material determination routines during creation. The business value is achieving touchless order processing for 95+ percent of electronic orders without manual intervention for discontinued parts. Next, we monitor process code ORDR error logs in transaction WE02 for unmapped material numbers. The weak answer is relying on custom IDoc mapping tables to translate materials before standard SD routines execute, creating dual maintenance overhead.
panel_qa.trap: Relying on custom IDoc mapping tables to translate materials before standard SD routines execute, creating dual maintenance overhead.

steps.step: Create sales order referencing customer 1000 and enter material NORM with quantity 10 in VA01.
steps.data: Order type OR, Sales Org 1000, Dist Ch 10, Division 10, Material NORM, Qty 10
steps.expected: System triggers material determination popup listing available substitute materials for selection.

steps.step: Select the desired substitute material from the popup list in VA01.
steps.data: Substitute material SUB01 selected from list
steps.expected: Sales order item updates main material field to SUB01 with quantity 10 and no sub-items generated.

steps.step: Save the sales order in VA01.
steps.data: Save action
steps.expected: Sales order is saved successfully and order number is generated.

steps.step: Create outbound delivery referencing the saved sales order in VL01N.
steps.data: Shipping Point 1010, Sales Order number
steps.expected: Outbound delivery document is created containing material SUB01.

steps.step: Post goods issue for the outbound delivery in VL02N.
steps.data: Delivery number, PGI button
steps.expected: Material document is posted and delivery status updates to complete.

steps.step: Create billing document for the delivery in VF01.
steps.data: Delivery number
steps.expected: Billing document is generated with correct pricing for material SUB01.

test_cases.expected_result: Sales order processes with manual material selection, resulting in delivery, goods issue, and billing for the chosen substitute material SUB01.

test_cases.title: Missing Condition Record Negative Test
test_cases.preconditions: No material determination condition record exists for the combination of customer and material.

test_cases.expected_result: Sales order proceeds with standard material NORM and no substitution popup is triggered; message VP110 'No substitution active' or standard item entry is accepted without error.

test_cases.title: Inactive Substitution Reason Edge Case
test_cases.preconditions: Material determination record exists in VB11 but references an unassigned or inactive substitution reason in OV41.

steps.step: Attempt to trigger manual material determination with an invalid substitution reason configuration in VA01.
steps.data: Material NORM with unassigned substitution reason
steps.expected: System does not display selection popup or issues configuration warning log.

test_cases.expected_result: Material determination fails to display selection options due to missing procedure assignment in OBA0 or OV41.
